title: Inspection checklists
description: Reusable inspection and handover checklist templates

help.title: About Inspection checklists
help.overview: An inspection checklist is a company-wide reusable template: a titled list of items with name, optional description and instructions, and importance. It is configuration. Ticks, retained rows, and the complete-gate live on each open inspection — never on this template.

sections.title: What a template holds
items: Title (required). Optional description, notes, trade, and stage.
At least one item: name (required), optional description and instructions, importance (low / medium / high).
Status: active or archived. Items have no completed flag here.
Company-wide — not scoped to a project, edifice, floor, or unit (unlike handover packages).

sections.title: How inspections use it
sections.body: Attach one template on an inspection. The inspection copies the items and stores the ticks.
items: While the inspection is open (scheduled, in progress, or rescheduled), it live-syncs from this template: added items appear, renamed items update, incomplete removed items drop.
A completed tick is kept if you later remove that item from the template — the inspection retains the row so history is not lost. You cannot untick a retained row.
Switching the template on an open inspection re-merges from the new list and keeps completed rows that no longer match.
Completed and cancelled inspections freeze: later edits here do not change them, and their ticks cannot be toggled.

sections.title: Complete gate
items: An inspection with a live checklist cannot be marked completed until every non-retained item is ticked.
Retained rows never block completion.
An inspection with no template and no leftover items has no checklist gate.

sections.title: Active and archived
items: Only active templates appear in the inspection picker.
Archiving hides the template from new selections. Open inspections that already use it keep syncing from it until they complete or cancel.
Soft-delete can be restored. Deleting a template that is still attached to open inspections leaves those inspections with the rows they already have.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create a template, add the items every matching inspection should walk through, then save.
Search and filter; open a card to inspect items. Edit title, notes, and items — keep existing item identities so open inspections treat a rename as an update, not a delete-and-add.
This list lives under Tenancy → Configurations, next to Handover packages.

sections.title: Not a handover package
items: Handover packages are scoped (project / edifice / floor / unit) and assemble additively on a sale.
Inspection checklists are a single company template you attach to an inspection visit.
Tick inspection items from the inspection (Update checklist). Tick handover items from the sale (Update handover).

sections.title: Related records
items: Inspections — attach the template, tick items, complete only when the live list is done.
Handover packages — the sale-side stacked checklist, next to this item in Configurations.

sections.title: Typical next step
items: Add an active template with the items a routine or handover inspection should confirm.
On a new inspection, pick that template. Tick items during the visit. Complete only after every live item is done.
